timeline.message: Implement the extra check for unassigned shards.
timeline.author: Nikola Grcevski
Nikola Grcevski

timeline.body:
`TransportGetShutdownStatusAction` has few checks that prevents a node from being shut down if there are shards without a copy which can't be moved. 

With this PR we also check if the node has unassigned primary shards and if it does, we return the STALLED status and prevent the node from being shut down. To ensure that the node was the last one to hold a copy of the unassigned shard, we check the `org.elasticsearch.cluster.routing.UnassignedInfo#lastAllocatedNodeId`.

- [x] Figure out what kind of integration tests I need to add

Closes #88635

timeline.body:
> Do we need any sort of timeout so that a node isnt left STALLED indefinitely if its cluster state gets out of sync & isnt updated? Or is that handled elsewhere in the infrastructure?

It should be up to the infrastructure to implement timeouts, if they don't want to permanently wait for a stalled node. We just need to ensure we don't cause data loss, if it's intentional by any orchestrator then they can always shutdown a stalled node.

+        allocation.setDebugMode(RoutingAllocation.DebugMode.EXCLUDE_YES_DECISIONS);

+        // We also need the set of node IDs which are currently shutting down.
+        Set<String> shuttingDownNodes = currentState.metadata().nodeShutdowns().keySet();
+
+        // Check if we have any unassigned primary shards that have this nodeId as their lastAllocatedNodeId
+        var unassignedShards = Stream.iterate(
+            currentState.getRoutingNodes().unassigned().iterator(),
+            Iterator::hasNext,
+            UnaryOperator.identity()
+        )
+            .map(Iterator::next)
+            .filter(s -> s.unassignedInfo().getLastAllocatedNodeId() != null && s.unassignedInfo().getLastAllocatedNodeId().equals(nodeId))
+            .collect(Collectors.toList());

timeline.body:
I think this number is misleading. It shows all of the unassigned shards but not all of them might stall the migration.
I believe it is possible to move `shardRouting.primary() || hasShardCopyOnAnotherNode(currentState, shardRouting, shuttingDownNodes) == false` check to the stream above. This way we would only have a list of shards that are stalling the migration.

reply.body: Good idea, I'll add another filter and simplify that check.
